newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: New air cargo sales agent starts up at Schiphol.
newsitem.headline: New air cargo sales agent starts up at Schiphol.

text.p: A new primarily cargo general sales agent, Meridian Worldwide Services BV, said it has just started operations at Amsterdam Schiphol airport.
It is currently specialising in the Latin American market, director Harry Komen told Reuters.
Meridian WWS is the European cargo gsa for Miami-based Florida West International Airways, which operates throughout Latin America.
The Schiphol agent feeds cargo into Miami on several charter airlines that operate to Florida, said Komen.
Another customer the new gsa represents on an off-line basis in the Netherlands is Colombian flower exporting company Aerofloral.
Aerofloral flies flowers from Bogota and Cali to Miami on Boeing 747 freighters wet-leased from Southern Air Transport. Wet-leasing covers the hire of both crew and aircraft.
Meridian's parent company is based in Houston, although the Dutch Meridian operates independently, added Komen, who said he worked for leading Dutch forwarder, ChartAir for 18 years.

"The general sales agency business is an over-crowded market but many carriers are still choosing to outsource their operations to agents because it is very expensive to have their own offices and own people in every country," he noted.
